author: John Hammond
description:
Cybercrime, like any other business, comes down to one thing: money. But where does that money go?

October 27th I'm stoked to sit down with @Mastercard's @Ann Johnson and investigative journalist @Geoff White to follow the money all the way from the moment it's taken... to the ways that defenders hit back. 💥

Tune in tomorrow for the season finale of _declassified: https://jh.live/declassified-ep4
title: Follow The Money

author: John Hammond
description:
What if you could explore malware research inside Minecraft? I’ve been using AI to build a mod that gamifies cybersecurity research, and for this experiment, I switched up the models to see what would happen.

Things didn’t go quite as planned. Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/bhbYRKI46VM?si=QzRc3VjCBwaXy7tr
title: AI Meets Minecraft
